the pinned lapce-client version is unrecorded for the same reason; a supported build identity is not guessed (Lapce 0.4.6 is channel-verified locally, see realClientChannelVerification, but the pin belongs to the reference capture)

the volt writes a one-time initialize launch-stamp line to host stderr behind uiTrace.enabled (default off, no UI notification) and dx-harness parses `verter launch-stamp`/`verter ui-stamp` lines both raw and embedded as host-log trailing fields (the real client's tracing rendering), joining their Unix-ms clock to the timeline clock only through a capture-recorded anchor (WSP1L.1/WSP1L.2)
